query_command: /妮姬 查询 练度 银华：战术升级

root_cause.summary: Nikke API returns official base costume TID 30049 in roster_item.costume_id / detail.costume_tid. NikkeDbProvider previously classified non-zero costume_id as an alternate costume and failed lookup in costumes.json, returning missing instead of c095.
root_cause.vulnerability: Treated base costume TIDs as unknown alternate skins, causing 76 newer characters to drop to grey placeholder when costume_id was returned from game server.

solution.character_master: Added default_costume_id=30049 and costume_id=0 to character_master.json for resource 95 and all 200 characters.
solution.resolver: Added CharacterMasterResolver.is_default_costume(resource_id, costume_id) supporting both 0/None and official default costume TIDs.
solution.provider: Integrated CharacterMasterResolver into NikkeDbProvider.resolve_character_id, resolve_render_id, and costume_cache_token to map default costume TIDs directly to default_id (c095).
solution.card_builder: Supported detail.costume_tid as fallback in CharacterCardBuilder.build.
